title: Polynomial-Time Randomized Computation Is Included in Expected-Time Randomized Computation
statement: Every language decidable in polynomial time by a randomized machine with one-sided error and acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members belongs to the class defined by a polynomial bound on cumulative probabilities of not yet halting, acceptance probability arbitrarily close to at least $2/3$ on members, and no accepting output on any halted branch for nonmembers.
